title: LEO Filter Sample DNA Extractions Using PowerWater Kit
author: MoBio PowerWater instructions amended with specific instructions
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iqycdxw

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and weigh out the filter samples.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize workspace with ethanol.
Prepare an ice bucket for filter storage.
Label bead tubes with full sample IDs.
Retrieve samples from -80°C freezer.
Crush frozen filters into evenly sized pieces using a rubber mallet while inside the closed baggie.
Tare balance with an empty baggie of the same size.
Weigh filter sample + baggie and record the mass.
Calculate 1/3 of the sample mass as the target mass.
Sterilize a clean spatula with ethanol and kimwipe.
Transfer the target mass into the bead tube, verifying the Sample Number on the tube and baggie match.
Record the mass and mark the baggie with date and initials.
Return remaining samples to the freezer box and clean the balance area.

steps.title: Warm Solution PW1
steps.instruction: Warm Solution PW1 to dissolve precipitates before use.

substeps.instruction: Heat Solution PW1 at 55°C for 5-10 minutes on a heating block.
Ensure the solution is used while still warm.

steps.title: Mechanical Lysis (Bead Beating)
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using a vortex adapter.

substeps.instruction: Secure the PowerWater® Bead Tube horizontally to a MO BIO Vortex Adapter (4 or 6 place adapter 13000-V1-15 or 13000-V1-5) with caps facing the center.
Vortex at maximum speed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate and collect the supernatant from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Place 5 mL Bead Tubes in 50 mL Conical tubes (secured with kimwipe) and centrifuge using a Thermo ST40R Centrifuge.
Draw up the supernatant using a 1 ml pipette tip, placing the tip down into the beads.
Pipette more than once to ensure full removal (expected recovery: 600-650 µl).

steps.title: Purification and Inhibitor Removal
steps.instruction: Perform centrifugation and reagent additions in a microcentrifuge to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge to remove remaining beads, proteins, and cell debris.
Add Solution PW2 and incubate tubes in the fridge.
Centrifuge and avoid transferring any of the pellet.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Prepare Solution PW3 and bind DNA to the silica membrane.

substeps.instruction: Check Solution PW3 for precipitation; if necessary, warm at 55°C for 5-10 minutes on the heating block.
Add Solution PW3 to the sample.
Transfer the sample to the Spin Filter basket in two loads per sample.
Place the Spin Filter basket into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove residual salts and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Wash the membrane with Solution PW4.
Wash the membrane with Solution PW5 to ensure complete removal of PW4.
Perform a second spin to remove all traces of Solution PW5 (ethanol).

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA using Solution PW6 into the final labeled collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the final collection tube is the one labeled with full sample details.
Add 70 µl of Solution PW6 (sterile elution buffer) to the center of the small white membrane to ensure it is fully wetted.

steps.title: Quantification via NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop-1000.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA extract tubes, P10 or P3 micropipette, tips, kimwipes, water, and PW6/EB.
Wipe the pedestal with a Kimwipe and add 2 μl of water, then click 'Ok'.
Add 2 μl of PW6/EB to blank the machine.
Add 2 μl of the sample, enter Sample ID, and record 260/280, 260/230, and ng/μL.
Run each sample 3x and calculate the average.
Between sample sets, run a 2 μl PW6/EB internal zero check.
Save the report using the format 'Date_LEO_seepage_DNA_extraction_x-y_initials'.
Clean the machine with a water run and wipe.
Store DNA samples in the appropriate freezer box and position in the -80°C freezer.
Upload extraction data to the 'LEO seepage microbial communities - DNA extraction log' Google Drive spreadsheet.
Note any procedural deviations (e.g., temperature errors) in the log.
Review lab notebook for completeness (date, mass, NanoDrop data).
